limitations_and_holds: Real BJT UI, S3 physical sensors, PLCs, lamp outputs and long thermal operation remain unvalidated; no real equipment was actuated by this review or these tests.
Microsoft Excel COM is not registered in the CI environment. Real Excel-engine validation is unperformed; mocked bookkeeping/formula/source preservation is not an Excel COM execution result.
Final algorithm, equipment application and stable release approval remain HOLD.

Tests use owned synthetic full-profile WinForms fixtures and normal taskbar roots. Owned/parking-window fallback and locked-desktop operation are not established. Hidden-session discovery uses an identity-checked fixture callback; separate normal job/PID cases use actual global/scoped native discovery.

CSV/log/native checks are bounded evidence, not an atomic physical transaction, and cannot independently prove that a plausible frozen sensor value is fresh.
